## Summary

**FMOVERZ** (Floating point Round to Zero, convert & Move (as Unsigned)).

## Details

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Operation | `FPn → Dn` |
| Syntax | `FMOVERZ.s Fpn,<ea>`<br>`FMOVEURZ.s FPn,<ea>` |
| Description | Move to ea (un)signed byte, word or long. |
| FP condition codes | see table |

### FP condition codes

| N | Z | I | nan |
|---|---|---|---|
| * | * | * | * |

### Encoding

| Word | Bits | Content |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 15–6 | `1111001000` |
| 1 | 5–3 | Mode |
| 1 | 2–0 | Register |
| 2 | 15–14 | `01` |
| 2 | 13 | D |
| 2 | 12–10 | Src |
| 2 | 9–7 | fpn |
| 2 | 6–0 | Opmode |

- Source Specifier 110=b 100=w 000=l
- Direction d=1: fpn,&lt;ea&gt;
- opmode 1=Round Zero , 3=Unsigned Round Zero

### Notes

- Not on V2

## Differences from AmigaOS / AROS / 68060

- The 68000–68060 have no FMOVERZ. It is new on the 68080.

## Do / Don't

- DON'T use FMOVERZ/FMOVEURZ on V2 cores.
